name: set_if_shares_scope
template: {% set x=1 %}{% if true %}{% set x=2 %}{% endif %}{{ x }}

name: set_loop_else_is_local
template: {% set x=9 %}{% for i in [] %}{% else %}{% set x=2 %}{{ x }}{% endfor %}|{{ x }}

name: set_autoescape_is_local
template: {% set x=9 %}{% autoescape true %}{% set x=2 %}{{ x }}{% endautoescape %}|{{ x }}

name: set_shadows_loop_alias
template: {% for i in [1,2] %}{% set i=8 %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}

name: set_capture_preserves_autoescape_safety
template: {% autoescape true %}{% set s %}{{ "<" }}{% endset %}{{ s }}|{{ s is escaped }}{% endautoescape %}

name: set_unpack_iterables_and_shared_cursor
template: {% set a,b='中😀'|safe %}{{ a }}{{ b }}|{{ a is escaped }}|{% set a,b={'x':1,'y':2,'x':3} %}{{ a }}{{ b }}|{% set a,b=range(2) %}{{ a }}{{ b }}|{% set it={'a':1,'b':2}|items %}{% set (k,v),(l,w)=it %}{{ k }}{{ v }}{{ l }}{{ w }}|{{ it|first is undefined }}

name: set_unpack_nested_scope_restoration
template: {% set a,b=8,9 %}{% for i in [1,2] %}{% set (i,a)=[7,i] %}{{ i }}{{ a }}{% endfor %}|{{ a }}{{ b }}|{% autoescape false %}{% set a,b=1,2 %}{{ a }}{{ b }}{% endautoescape %}|{{ a }}{{ b }}

name: set_capture_nested_local_values
template: {% set x=9 %}{% set s %}{% set x=2 %}{{ x }}{% set inner %}I{% endset %}{{ inner }}{% endset %}{{ s }}|{{ x }}|{{ inner is undefined }}

name: set_capture_filter_scope_and_native_result
template: {% set x=9 %}{% set y|default(x,true) %}{% set x=7 %}{% endset %}{{ y }}|{{ x }}|{% autoescape true %}{% set s %}{{ '<' }}{% endset %}{{ s }}|{{ s is escaped }}{% endautoescape %}|{% set n|length %}abc{% endset %}{{ n is integer }}:{{ n }}

name: set_capture_tuple_targets_and_markup_wrapping
template: {% set a,b|trim %} ab {% endset %}{{ a }}{{ b }}|{% set c, %}C{% endset %}{{ c }}|{% autoescape true %}{% set n|length %}abc{% endset %}{{ n is string }}:{{ n is escaped }}:{{ n }}{% endautoescape %}

name: set_capture_loop_scope
template: {% set x='old' %}{% for i in [1,2] %}{% set x %}{{ i }}{% endset %}{{ x }}{% endfor %}|{{ x }}
